system.description: Whether by accident or a rival's malice, your name and all traces of your existence have been erased from the earth. No one remembers your name, no writings speak of you, and no mortal descendants or vampire progeny exist who bear your name. In Egyptian tradition you have become a non-entity. As far as your clan is concerned, you no longer exist — you have no status, nor will any future progeny you create. Worse, it is a sacred duty for any Setite who encounters you to diablerize you and return Set's vitae to his remaining children. Any wealth, lands, or property in your possession may be taken from you by other Setites without fear of retribution.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three
